answer.book: A Latin theological dissertation (1692) by Samuel Dick, defended under the presidency of David Albinus at Bern: a title page and a dedication to Sigismund ab Erlach precede one continuous argument, divided into numbered Roman-numeral sections I to XVIII.

entries.title: Viro amplissimo, magnificentissimo, generosissimo, consultissimo, prosapia pariter ac virtutis nobilitate splendidissimo Domino, Dn. Sigismundo ab Erlach, Totius Helveticae militiae generalissimo, Florent. Reip. Bernen. consuli gravissimo, prudentissimo, Patri patriae, Domino atque Baroni in Spiez clementissimo, suo è sacro baptismatis fonte susceptori benignissimo ac Patrono summo, nullis non honoribus perpetim prosequendo, colendo;
Dissertatio theologica, de ΚΑΥΧΗΣΙ hominis Christiani.
